title: File:Taller mapeo Venado Tuerto Mayo 2026 05.jpg
desc: Day 3 of the workshop "Open Tools for the Production and Use of Cartographic Data" in Venado Tuerto, Argentina, from May 28-30, 2026. Participants are mapping in the field, using their phones and instant messaging. They are taking photos of areas regularly affected by flooding and illegal dumpsites.
